2026-03.author: Copilot
2026-03.body:
GitHub release bodies rendered via `markdownify` in `_github_markdown_parser.html` were emitted verbatim into the page — raw HTML tags like `<script>` or event handler attributes in any release note would execute in users' browsers.

## Change

Added `strip_html` as the first filter in the `release.body` pipeline, before regex transforms and `markdownify`:

```liquid
{{ release.body
  | strip_html
  | regexreplace: reLineBreakBeforeHeader, '\1\1#'
  | ...
  | markdownify
}}
```
